purpose: Define required 5-layer lifts and module evidence gates for true SEIS-level progress in God Mode development.
operatingBehavior: Cross-layer module evidence must exist for Dashboard/Goals/Repos/Docs/Agents before any completion claim.
No claim of feature completeness without validation + security + rollback proof.
No public release posture without commit/push/CI evidence or an explicit handoff waiver.
Every active module lane must keep an auditable rollback slice.
CI-triggered changes must remain gate-consistent across quality, security, AI, and docs layers.

featureScope.newFeatureRule: If any module lacks evidence, required layer lift, or verification, the project state is not-complete and no God Mode completion claim is valid.
